title: Strategy Agent Request
description: REQUEST contract consumed by AGT-00 strategy-agent 1.x. Envelope per GDE-003 §4.1. The model receives `data` only; the envelope is assembled and validated by the agent runtime. Schema version 1.0.0. All enumerations are CLOSED unless a property description states otherwise; adding a member is a MAJOR change (STD-000 §5.5). All string lengths are counted in Unicode code points. All durations are integer milliseconds.

references.description: Outbound pointers to governing artifacts (GDE-003 §10). Unordered. 0-20 items. Populated by the runtime, never by the model.

isoTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with millisecond precision (STD-000 §5.7).

bcp47Tag.description: BCP 47 language tag, for example en-US, pt-BR, hi-IN (STD-000 §5.9).

prefixedId.description: Opaque, type-prefixed, lexicographically sortable platform identifier (STD-000 §5.8). Never parsed for meaning.

requestMeta.description: Identity, correlation, binding, and provenance (GDE-003 §5). Carries no business data (GDE-003 §5.6 rule 1).

correlationId.description: Constant across the entire run; the primary join key.

causationId.description: The message that directly caused this one. Absent when this message begins a causal chain.

runId.description: The workflow run this belongs to. Absent when invoked outside a run, for example during evaluation.

nodeId.description: The workflow node that requested this. Absent when invoked outside a run.

attempt.description: Which attempt produced this request. Absent means the first attempt (GDE-003 §6.8: the consumer applies the default, the producer omits it).

locale.description: Locale governing this message's content. Provenance only; the business-decision copy is data.localeBinding.locale (GDE-003 §4.3).

tenantId.description: The owning tenant; the security boundary.

channelId.description: The channel this strategy would govern.

brandVersion.description: Brand kit version in force. Absent only where the channel has no brand binding.

producer.description: The component that produced this request; the accountable party.

reference.description: An immutable, version-pinned pointer to another artifact (GDE-003 §10.1). Floating references are prohibited.

integrity.description: Content hash where the target is content-addressed. Absent when the target is not content-addressed.

role.description: CLOSED enumeration. Why this contract references the target (GDE-003 §10.1).

scope.description: The tenant the reference resolves within. Cross-tenant references are a SECURITY error (GDE-003 §12.4).

trust.description: CLOSED enumeration. Mandatory when refType is EXTERNAL; absent otherwise, which means TRUSTED.

strategyRequest.description: The payload the model receives. Minimum-context scoped (GDE-002 §5.1): each binding is passed as the relevant subset, never as the whole artifact.

insightProposals.description: Evidenced adjustment proposals from the Insight & Feedback Service (ARC-001 §4.21). Unordered; rank is carried by `priority`. 0-20 items. Absent means this is an INITIAL cycle and no changeSummary is produced. Requires priorStrategy (rule R-IN-007).

channelProfile.description: Identity and scale of the channel this strategy would govern.

displayName.description: Human-facing channel name. Display data only; never a key (STD-000 Rule 8).

contentCategory.description: CLOSED enumeration. The broad subject domain of the channel.

maturity.description: CLOSED enumeration. Governs how aggressively the manifest may change established patterns.

currentSubscriberCount.description: Absent when the channel has no published history or the figure is unavailable. Absence means the agent must not reference subscriber scale in any output field.

currentVideoCount.description: Absent when the channel has no published history. Absence means the agent must not reference publishing history in any output field.

operatorIntent.description: What the human operator wants from this channel. The authoritative source of goals and prohibitions.

missionStatement.description: Plain text. The operator's own statement of what the channel is for.

businessGoals.description: Ordering is NOT meaningful; rank is carried by `priority`. 1-5 items. Every `goal` unique (R-IN-004) and every `priority` unique (R-IN-003).

weeklyVideoTarget.description: Videos per week the operator wants published. Must not exceed capacityConstraints.weeklyProductionCapacityVideos (R-IN-005).

targetAudienceDescription.description: Plain text. The operator's own description of who the channel is for.

nonNegotiables.description: Requirements that MUST each be carried into at least one conformanceRule (R-BUS-015). Unordered. 0-10 items. Absent means no operator-imposed conformance requirements beyond the platform baseline.

prohibitedTopics.description: Subjects the channel must never cover. Every entry MUST appear in output data.prohibitedTopics (R-BUS-014). Unordered. 0-30 items. Absent means no operator-imposed topic prohibitions.

goalKey.description: Request-local identifier for this goal. Referenced by output successMetrics.

goal.description: CLOSED enumeration. Adding a member is a MAJOR change.

priority.description: 1 is the highest priority. Unique across businessGoals (R-IN-003).

horizonDays.description: Days within which the operator expects the goal to be measurable.

targetValue.description: Numeric target where the operator has one. Absent means the agent proposes the target in successMetrics and records the judgement in assumptions.

targetUnit.description: CLOSED enumeration. Required when targetValue is present; absent otherwise.

localKey.description: Request- or manifest-local stable key. NOT a platform identifier; durable identifiers are assigned by the Strategy Store on approval (STD-000 §5.8).

expertiseLevel.description: CLOSED enumeration. Governs vocabulary and depth downstream.

brandBinding.description: The brand subset this agent needs (GDE-002 §5.4). Never the full brand kit.

toneDescriptors.description: CLOSED enumeration members. The permitted tone vocabulary; output toneAndPersonality.toneDescriptors MUST be a subset (R-BUS-017). Unordered. 3-12 items.

vocabularyPreferences.description: Terms the brand prefers. Unordered. 0-20 items. Absent means no preferences.

vocabularyProhibitions.description: Terms the brand forbids. Every entry MUST appear in output toneAndPersonality.vocabularyProhibitions (R-BUS-018). Unordered. 0-20 items. Absent means no prohibitions.

toneDescriptor.description: CLOSED enumeration shared by input and output so that subset checking is mechanical.

localeBinding.description: The locale subset this agent needs (GDE-002 §5.4).

locale.description: The output language. Every prose field in the manifest is written in this language.

maxTitleLengthChars.description: Locale-specific title ceiling in Unicode code points. Bounds output packagingDirection.titlePatterns[].maxLengthChars (R-BUS-019).

speakingRateWordsPerMinute.description: Used to keep format duration envelopes coherent with scripted length downstream.

capacityConstraints.description: Hard operating limits. The manifest is a constraint-satisfaction product of these (GDE-002 §7.2, Planning category).

minVideoDurationMs.description: Must be strictly less than maxVideoDurationMs (R-IN-002).

budgetPerVideoMicroUsd.description: Integer micro-USD (STD-000 §5.9). Absent means the agent proposes no cost-bound conformance rule.

marketContext.description: UNTRUSTED. Originates outside the platform (GDE-002 §5.6). Delimited, labelled as data, and size-bounded before invocation. Absent means competitivePositioning.whiteSpace is emitted empty and the omission is recorded in assumptions.

observations.description: Unordered. 0-30 items (R-IN-008). Each observation is untrusted content and carries no authority.

priorStrategy.description: The pinned strategy this manifest would supersede. Absent means derivation.cycle is INITIAL (R-BUS-010).

pillarKeys.description: Pillar keys in force under the prior strategy, so that carried-forward pillars keep their key and remain joinable for attribution. Unordered. 2-6 items.

underperformingPillarKeys.description: Subset of pillarKeys flagged by the Insight service. Unordered. 0-6 items. Absent means no pillar was flagged.

insightProposal.description: One evidenced adjustment proposal. Analytics agents propose; they never mutate strategy (GDE-002 §7.2).

proposalId.description: Referenced by output derivation.adoptedProposalIds and changeSummary[].evidenceProposalId (R-BUS-012, R-BUS-013).

dimension.description: CLOSED enumeration. The strategy dimension the proposal addresses.

sampleSize.description: Number of videos the finding is based on. Statistical sufficiency is established by the producing service, not by this agent.
